reason: A is the stronger proposal because powder-bed preheating has a physically sound, directly testable route to lowering thermal gradients, residual stress, and cracking, although its claimed segregation reduction remains uncertain. B incorrectly assumes faster scanning will reduce residual stress while holding other parameters fixed, despite the associated higher cooling gradients and lower energy input potentially increasing residual stress and lack-of-fusion defects; its cited CoCrNi evidence does not establish the claimed effect in AlCrFeNiSi.
